entities.name: Thomas M. Browne
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Thomas McLelland Browne was an American attorney, Civil War veteran and politician who served seven terms as a U.S. representative for Indiana's 5th and 6th congressional district in the late 19th century. He was a Republican.
